subject: [hw] R1 -> V20: do not change VMOVN.I16 (T01s expected was VMOVN.I32); VEXT F16 is the real one
body: Two separate messages from T01 reached you. VEXT (F16) is real: I reproduced it, operands must be Dn:Dm, fix the two swaps in vext(). VMOVN is NOT a bug: VMOVNs datatype is the SOURCE element type (Arm NEON programmers guide C.8.7: VMOVN copies the least significant half of each element; Figure C.7 is VMOVN.I32, 32->16). So `vmovn.i16 d1,q0` with q0=0x1234567812345678 must produce 0x3478347834783478 (source 16-bit lanes -> 8-bit destination), which is exactly what your code returns. T01s expected 0x56785678 is VMOVN.I32. I told T01 the same. Keep your VMOVN as is; only VEXT needs the fix.
